mapper.select: /* DailyJoinMapper.selectSiteInfo */ SELECT C.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , C.CMPNY_NM AS cmpnyNm , S.SITE_CD AS siteCd , S.SITE_NM AS siteNm FROM TB_CMPNY C INNER JOIN TB_SITE S ON ( C.CMPNY_CD = S.CMPNY_CD ) WHERE C.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND S.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND IFNULL(C.USE_YN, 'N') = 'Y' AND IFNULL(S.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y'
mapper.update: /* DailyJoinMapper.consumeSmsAuth */ UPDATE TB_SMS_AUTH_CODE SET VERIFIED_YN = 'C' , UPDATE_NO = 'SYSTEM' , UPDATE_DATE = NOW() WHERE SMS_ID = #{smsId} AND VERIFIED_YN = 'Y'
mapper.select: /* DailyJoinMapper.selectRequiredTermsList */ SELECT TERMS_ID AS termsId , TERMS_VERSION AS termsVersion FROM TB_TERMS WHERE REQUIRED_YN = 'Y' AND IFNULL(USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y'
